_description: Annual hospitalisation and outpatient cost assumptions per condition, in INR. Used by the Monte Carlo plan simulator.
_status: ILLUSTRATIVE ASSUMPTIONS. These are order-of-magnitude placeholders chosen to make the system work end to end. Before final submission, replace every value with a cited Indian figure (e.g. NSS 75th round 'Health in India' hospitalisation expenditure, AB-PMJAY health benefit package rates, insurer/IRDAI claim reports, published cost-of-illness studies) and record the source in the 'source' field.
cost_model: Hospitalisation cost per event ~ LogNormal(mean = hosp_cost_mean_inr, sigma = hosp_cost_sigma). At most one hospitalisation per condition per year.

baseline._note: Hospitalisations not tied to the modelled conditions (accidents, infections, surgery, etc.). Probability per year by age.
